feature_contract.goal: Ensure the original stage-extension +TIME native sprite children and numeric glyphs never receive an R84 fixed-function or XYZRHW LEFT/RIGHT eye pair from a foreign or stale original game c64 shader upload, preserving valid same-shader and truly absent tracker fallbacks.
feature_contract.scope_boundary: Only +TIME stage physical raw-WVP identity under R84 fixed-function/XYZRHW entry and matching R33 shader owner; no GOAL, generic HUD, F11, ESC, lens, world, input, FFB, SkyGlow, R26_SAFE, DX11 or frozen DXVK changes.
trace_stages: Original EXE 0x00498670 stage +TIME producer and three sprite E8 calls at 0x9898E/0x98A36/0x98AC6 plus numeric glyph calls at 0x989AD/0x98A89/0x98A10 establish exact StageExtensionTime screen HUD ownership.

The original SpriteNode queue or direct D3DX stage glyph binds exact source and the source-backed shader/pose/c64 epoch before physical GPU Draw; the existing R33 shader path rejects a captured foreign raw shader upload.

R84 R30 fixed-function and XYZRHW physical LEFT/RIGHT Draw capture now evaluates the same captured original shader and shader-epoch contract before recording raw c64 generation, then preserves same-node, original-HRESULT and right-eye restore fences.
subcomponents: Implement shader/epoch ownership parity in the real R30 +TIME physical source capture for both fixed-function and XYZRHW draws, rejecting known foreign or incomplete game WVP while keeping the unavailable raw tracker native fallback.
Extend executable stage-extension eye-plane smoke with positive original-shader and unknown-tracker cases plus mismatched shader, epoch and malformed original source negative cases.
Run final exact-SHA Windows game, OpenXR host and package and Domain, Inspector and Full Source Impact checks without suppressing output or changing unrelated source paths.

acceptance_items.expected_behavior: Both +TIME sprites and numeric glyphs use only an original game c64 writer from their verified current shader and epoch for left and right native eye draws; a foreign captured raw writer is refused.
A truly absent original c64 capture remains zero/zero and uses unchanged safe R84 fallback, while an available mismatched or incomplete source never acquires an unrelated +TIME eye owner.

The same final validation-bearing exact SHA must pass DX9Ex Active x86 R84 game and x64 OpenXR host and package plus Domain Isolation, HUD Inspector and Full Source Impact; Quest3 hardware remains UNTESTED.

diagnosis.original_evidence: Source cross-check at R84 R30CaptureStagePhysicalSource and R33 captureStageSource on latest vr-d3d9ex-focus; R33 already called MatchesCapturedOriginalWvp but R30 unconditionally stamped the last available raw game WVP serial even if its shader/epoch was from another draw.
diagnosis.root_cause: R30 fixed-function/XYZRHW stage +TIME physical source accepted a captured prior game c64 matrix without verifying that its shader identity and epoch matched the current stage physical GPU command. Consequently an unrelated original writer could supply a stale raw WVP generation without the R33 shader path veto.
source_trace: Original +TIME three animated sprite and three numeric glyph callers -> exact StageExtensionTime tagging -> queue/direct D3DX GPU batch route.

R30CaptureStagePhysicalSource -> CapturePhysicalDrawCommand -> R29OwnerCurrentShaderEpoch and GetLastRawGameWvpWrite -> MatchesCapturedOriginalWvp now validates physical current shader, written shader, epoch and nonzero serial before LEFT.

R30 physical LEFT native Draw and RIGHT pre-RT/depth/viewport state fence -> SameAfterNativeLeft verifies that the exact StageExtensionTime queue node and current original c64 generation survive; R33 already held the shader analog.
diagnosis.eye_ownership: The bounded R30 source repair refuses known foreign original-game shader constant uploads before stereo; previously valid current source and missing tracker use established native routing. Quest3/VDXR left/right actual visual alignment is not established.
alternatives_rejected: Do not classify all alpha or fixed-function HUD as stage +TIME; original source must be exact StageExtensionTime.
Do not borrow injected live GPU c64 as original game WVP when tracker is missing, force D3DX Flush of mixed batches, or discard original native draw input and state recovery.
